About me

AVX A is the official name of this site. I am Vikas Kumar. My stage name and personal brand is A, and friends call me VEHAN. I am learning, experimenting and building: chatbots, backend servers, web interfaces and early language-model experiments.

My goal is an independent technology ecosystem under my own brands, with original AI models at the centre. I describe my work by what I have actually built, and I mark every plan as a plan.

Think Beyond Limits. Build the Future. Stay Unstoppable.

Vision, not trained

VAEON-X3 Ultra 480B-M48B

The planned flagship model of VaeonAI. It sets the direction for efficient architecture, multilingual ability, reasoning, coding and productivity.

480B-M48BPlanned specification
~14.18MParams in today's prototype
32,768Prototype vocabulary
6 layersPrototype depth

The 480B-M48B name is my intended specification. No 480-billion-parameter model has been trained or deployed. The prototype is early-stage and still being tested.
